In the Contract the following words have the meanings stated, unless the context requires otherwise:

- "Works" means the permanent works and temporary works required to deliver the complete power plant described in the Employer's Requirements.
- "Site" means the land made available by the Owner as described in ER-02.01, including the marine areas for intake and outfall.
- "Engineer" means the person appointed by the Owner to act as the Owner's engineer and notified to the Contractor.
- "Taking-Over" means the stage at which the Owner takes over the Works under Clause 11.
- "Defects Notification Period" means the period stated in Sub-Clause 13.1.
- "Site Reference Conditions" means the conditions stated in ER-02.03.
- "Good Industry Practice" means the skill, diligence and foresight reasonably expected of an experienced international contractor executing works of similar size and complexity.
- "Owner's Database" means the engineering database designated by the Owner as the single source of project data.
title: Definitions
